PLAN "PCOS Resistance Foundation — 12 Week Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS

PHASES

    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          leg_swings 1x10
          hip_circles 1x10
          bodyweight goblet_squat 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 seconds rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 3m
          hamstring_stretch 1x30 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 1x30 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body A":

          rowing 5m

          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 3m
          chest_stretch 1x30 seconds
          lat_stretch 1x30 seconds
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
          cat_cow 1x10
          bird_dog 2x10
        main straight_sets:
